etymologies.etymologyHTML: From care +‎ -free.

definitions.definition: Without cares or worries; free of concern or worries; without difficulty.

quote.citation: 1964, Sol Marcus, Gloria Caldwell, Bennie Benjamin (lyrics and music), “Don’t Let Me Be Misunderstood”, performed by Nina Simone:
quote.text: You know: sometimes, baby, I'm so carefree / With a joy that's hard to hide
